source.title: Introduction to Particle Cosmology: The Standard Model of Cosmology and its Open Problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document id 6482757. Direct local fetches of zbmath.org encountered a Cloudflare challenge or local DNS failure, and api.zbmath.org/oai.zbmath.org were only reachable through gated terms pages in browser search results. Local resolver rows in outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv and outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv identify the same work as 'Introduction to particle cosmology. The standard model of cosmology and its open problems', DOI 10.1007/978-3-662-48078-6, published in 2016.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted / metadata_only. Exact-work searches for the DOI and title led to the Springer book landing page https://link.springer.com/book/10.1007/978-3-662-48078-6, which visibly confirms the title, subtitle, authors, DOI, and table of contents but states that the book is preview subscription content. The direct Springer PDF endpoint https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/978-3-662-48078-6.pdf returned the same subscription-preview HTML rather than a readable PDF. Other inspected exact-work candidates included a Springer chapter preview, a CiNii bibliographic record, and a KIT library catalog record; these were rejected because they expose abstracts, problem/exercise snippets, or metadata, not a readable full-text artifact for the whole book.

No readable primary PDF or full HTML source was established. The visible Springer structure shows a book landing page with thirteen chapters and separate chapter preview pages, but the pages are not full text.

Candidate extraction was not performed because the only readable content was restricted to resolver metadata, landing-page description, chapter abstracts, references, and preview snippets. Per the source adequacy rule, those materials were not used as technical evidence for open-problem extraction.

Extraction stopped before accepted-question generation because no exact-work readable full-text source was recovered within the bounded recovery pass. Accepted output is empty and the run is marked for review with invalid_or_unreadable_input.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/6482757.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
